entry.intro: Two to four players collect gems, buy cards and win the favour of nobles. Computer players can fill any empty seats.

leaveConfirm: A computer player takes your seat if you leave.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.hostOnly: Only the host can change these.
